Subject: Vendor setup kickoff — tax package, PO timeline & action tracker

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for the integration work. I'm kicking off procurement for ClearWave so we can get your PO out and payments flowing once work begins. To keep things moving, can you please do the following by EOD Tue (2026-11-12):

1) Confirm legal entity name and address exactly as you want them on the PO.
2) Upload your tax form: W-9 (if US entity) or W-8BEN-E (if non-US). If you have EU VAT registration, please attach the VAT certificate as well.
3) Provide preferred remittance contact email and invoice template (PDF).
4) Upload bank details via our secure portal (link below) — do not email account numbers in the thread.

Secure upload: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-onboarding-uploads (we can also send a DocuSign envelope if you prefer).

I've attached our vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf for reference and a sample PO template so you know the fields we'll populate. Once we receive the W-9/W-8 and bank details, procurement (Marissa) will issue the PO within 48 business hours. If you have any constraints on the payment term (Net30/Net45) flag them here.

If you need someone from legal early, I've CC'd Jonas.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
[Attachment: vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf (PDF)]

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the note — happy to get this over. Quick questions before I upload:

- We are a US entity but also have an EU branch — should we submit a single W-9 for the US HQ and the EU VAT cert separately?

I'll prepare the W-9 and bank details. We prefer DocuSign for bank info.

Hi Elena —

Answers below:
- DUNS: optional for our standard vendor profile; we only require it for certain enterprise customers or if you request it be on the PO. You can leave it blank for now.
- For the EU branch: yes — please upload the W-9 for the US HQ and the EU VAT certificate for the EU branch (two separate docs). We'll store both and apply VAT handling to invoices originating from the EU entity.
- Supplier diversity: optional. If you have a certification and want it on file, feel free to include it but it won't block PO issuance.

DocuSign for bank details works — I'll trigger the secure envelope if you confirm the recipient email. Otherwise the Drive upload link is fine.

Timeline recap: once HR/Finance receives the W-9 and bank details, procurement will create the vendor record and Marissa will issue the PO within ~48 business hours. If anything is missing we'll flag it in HubSpot and ping you.

DocuSign envelope (bank details): https://redwood.docusign.com/envelope/ABC12345
Onboarding checklist (attached): vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf

Thanks —
Hannah
